info.name: Bookmark LMS — DA3 Software Testing
info.description:
DA3 Software Testing collection for Bookmark Digital Library Management System.

Organised into three DA3 categories:
1. Functional E2E Tests – login, book CRUD, member operations, issue/return flows
2. Boundary & Edge Case Tests – missing/invalid inputs, duplicates, invalid IDs
3. Integration Tests – database persistence, inventory consistency, loan lifecycle

Pre-requisite: Start the Spring Boot backend (port 8080) and import the Bookmark_DA3_Environment.json.
Run the collection with the Postman Collection Runner in order (top to bottom).
